title: Corset by Candlelight
reference_source: Бельевая линия — максимальный гламурный регистр, 8 кадров, без наушников
mood_ru: Кирпичный погреб, десятки свечей, корсет с подвязками. Самый тёмный и плотный свет.
allure: lingerie editorial glamour at its boldest, set with full opaque lining, deep neckline and high-cut briefs, sculpted waist and long legs fully on show, unhurried commanding sensuality, direct gaze, laced corset with garter straps and stockings, candle flame on bare skin
film: shot on Cinestill 800T pushed one stop, heavy grain and candle halation

wardrobe.notes_ru: Корсет со шнуровкой + подвязки и чулки, плотная ткань.
wardrobe.prompt: black laced corset with structured boning and full opaque lining, matching garter belt with straps clipped to sheer black stockings, high-cut briefs, silver star pendant, hair loose and falling forward, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Кирпичный погреб, дубовые бочки, только свечи как источник света.
location.prompt: brick vaulted wine cellar, rows of dusty bottles, old oak barrels, dozens of lit candles on the stone floor and ledges, cobwebs in the corners, no other light source

shots.pose: standing among the candles with her back half to the camera, both hands pulling the corset laces tight behind her, shoulder blades drawn together, head turned to find the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, thigh-up framing
shots.light: dozens of candle flames from below and the side, deep black brick behind

shots.pose: sitting on the old oak barrel with one heel up on its rim, elbow on that knee, the other leg long to the floor, garter strap taut, slow heavy-lidded look at the camera
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera, three-quarter front, full body framing
shots.light: candlelight pooling warm on her legs and chest, everything beyond falling to black

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the flat top of the oak barrel, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: dozens of candle flames from below, flickering warm, one cooler shaft from the cellar archway behind her

shots.pose: standing close to a dark sheet of glass leaning against the brick, one hand flat on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, meeting the camera past her own reflection
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: dozens of candle flames from below, flickering warm, one cooler shaft from the cellar archway behind her

shots.pose: standing at the narrow cellar archway with light beyond with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, the long line of her back and legs read against the light, head turned just enough to find the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: dozens of candle flames from below, flickering warm, one cooler shaft from the cellar archway behind her

shots.pose: reclining back on the flat top of the oak barrel propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: dozens of candle flames from below, flickering warm, one cooler shaft from the cellar archway behind her

shots.pose: standing tall among the candles on the stone floor, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight on one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: dozens of candle flames from below, flickering warm, one cooler shaft from the cellar archway behind her

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the garter strap clipped to the stocking top and the corset lacing at her waist, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: dozens of candle flames from below, flickering warm, one cooler shaft from the cellar archway behind her
